message:
- **We pull it**, Instructions: Manage Account → API Tokens → Create Token → Create Custom Token → tick every Read permission group under Account and Zone, set Resources to All accounts / All zones, the account-token option only appears if you are a Super Administrator, and a user token won't see zones you don't own. Then R2 → API → Manage API tokens → Create token (Object Read) for an Access Key ID + Secret; send all credentials to use over secure means.

Let me know if you would prefer to push this, or if you have any questions!
notes: The account-token option only appears for Super Administrators; a user token cannot see zones the user does not own.
Pull coverage follows the Read permission groups granted on the token.
